title: Trie Prefix Search
prompt:
Implement `PrefixTrie` for a minimal prefix-search contract.

- `PrefixTrie(words=())` inserts each initial word.
- `insert(word)` adds one nonempty string. Inserting an existing word is a no-op.
- `contains(word) -> bool` reports exact membership.
- `complete(prefix) -> list[str]` returns every stored word that begins with `prefix`, in lexicographic order. The empty prefix enumerates all stored words.

Words are case-sensitive. `word` must be a nonempty string; `prefix` must be a string and may be empty. Raise an error for invalid arguments. Use a trie so lookup follows the prefix rather than scanning every stored word.

Invalid inputs may be rejected with `assert`.

example.reasoning: Only complete stored words with the requested prefix are returned, including the prefix itself when it is a word.
